statements.text: When Meta trades at its all-time high inside a sideways phase on rising volume, the price rose in 88 % of 8 independent cases within 13 trading days.
When Meta trades at its all-time high inside a sideways phase on falling volume, the price rose in 75 % of 8 independent cases within one trading day.
After a fall of 20 % from its all-time high, Meta came back every time: in all 5 cases since 2016 the old high was reached again within 24 months at most.
After a fall of 30 % from its all-time high, Meta came back every time: in all 4 cases since 2016 the old high was reached again within 24 months at most.
